The '''1957 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 55th staging of the [[Copa del Rey|Spanish Cup]]. The competition began on 28 April 1957 and concluded on 16 June 1957 with the final.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Ferrer |first=Carles Lozano |date=2001-10-04 |title=Spain - Cup 1957 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1957.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260214103150/https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1957.html |archive-date=2026-02-14 |access-date=2026-03-21 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>
